title: Refrain reference-protocol meta tags
description: The shared, versioned contract for the `meta` tags that organize the protocol library. Refrain itself is meta-agnostic; host apps read these tags (via refrain.read_meta) to group/filter/search. Unknown fields are permitted and ignored; unknown enum values fall into an 'Other' bucket rather than being dropped.

description.description: One-line human label shown in the picker.

title.description: Plain-language, goal-first name shown as the primary label (e.g. 'Calm the mind — boost alpha').

summary.description: One non-specialist sentence describing what the protocol trains.

family.description: Shared id across a concept's variant files; the picker groups by it.

status.description: OUR file maturity / test status (distinct from clinical `evidence`). 'legacy' marks a protocol superseded by a newer one: still runnable, hidden from the default picker.

citation.description: Author-anchored reference; required once status > draft.

goals.description: Clinical-goal categories (MULTI-membership). Drives the picker's groups. Controlled vocab; unknown values land in 'Other'.

bands.description: Band chips shown on the row.

threshold_style.description: Drives the Adaptive / Baseline filter chip. 'selectable' = the protocol exposes a `mode` control offering both.

hardware.description: Amp class the protocol targets. 'clinical_amp' = greyed out on a consumer amp.

requires_features.description: Engine/hardware features the protocol needs (e.g. dc_coupling, trials). Used to grey-out unrunnable protocols.
